prompt: A gaunt peasant man in tattered grey-brown rags kneels in rigid side profile facing south-west, his trembling arm forced outstretched, one finger pointing to condemn, his face twisted in anguish and tears. A black-gloved tyrant hand thrusts a wax-sealed edict scroll at him from the right edge. Behind him in deep shadow stand three of his own kin as faint silhouettes; the one he points at is already crumbling to grey bone-ash and crimson. The only saturated color is the red wax seal and a thin crimson smear. The background is a torchlit stone dungeon hall, oppressive and dark.

A skeletal black-robed enforcer looms at the right edge holding a black wax-sealed decree. The only saturated color is the crimson blood. The background is a cold candlelit stone keep with deep violet shadow.
